title: The boy walks home
logline: The boy from the fence walking the beach road home, from behind, the stack cold behind him in the distance, the bay, no dog yet. The page the sequence didn't need and drew anyway. Which boy: still not said.

panels.composition: A thin boy in a too-big jacket walking away down a beach road seen from behind, a cold mill stack small in the distance behind him, the bay gray beside the road, no dog. Era I spotting on the road's edge.
